title: Spec of a local ring of a scheme is the limit of the affine open neighbourhoods of the point
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $x\in X$, $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ its local ring [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] and $g_x:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x}\to X$ the canonical morphism [lem-weil-pbc-spec-local-ring-canonical-morphism] ($\operatorname{Spec}$ as in [def-weil-affine-spectrum]). Let $N_x$ be the set of affine open subschemes $W\subseteq X$ with $x\in W$ ([def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]: $W$ is isomorphic to the spectrum of a ring), ordered by $W'\ge W$ if and only if $W'\subseteq W$; for $W'\subseteq W$ in $N_x$ let $j_{W'W}:W'\to W$ be the inclusion, an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Then: (1) every open subset $U\subseteq X$ with $x\in U$ contains some $W\in N_x$; in particular $N_x$ is nonempty and directed (for $W,W'\in N_x$ there is $W''\in N_x$ with $W''\subseteq W\cap W'$), and $(W,j_{W'W})$ is an inverse system of schemes over $N_x$. (2) Every $W\in N_x$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and every $j_{W'W}$ is an affine morphism ([def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [pqf-def-affine-morphism]). (3) For every open $U\ni x$ there is a unique morphism $g_{x,U}:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x}\to U$ with $j_U\circ g_{x,U}=g_x$, $j_U:U\to X$ the inclusion, and $(\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x},(g_{x,W})_{W\in N_x})$ is a limit of the inverse system $(W,j_{W'W})_{W\in N_x}$ in the category of schemes ([def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], dually): for every scheme $T$ and morphisms $t_W:T\to W$ with $j_{W'W}\circ t_{W'}=t_W$ for all $W'\subseteq W$ in $N_x$ there is exactly one morphism $t:T\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x}$ with $g_{x,W}\circ t=t_W$ for all $W\in N_x$.

proof.text: Let N be the subtype of affine open neighbourhoods of x. Its inclusion i into OpenNhds x is monotone. N is nonempty and directed in the reverse order, and every open neighbourhood contains an element of N by the affine basis. Functor.final_of_exists_of_isFiltered proves i.op.Final (parallel arrows in the poset are equal). Whisker the standard stalk colimit cocone by i.op and apply Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv. Thus the stalk is the colimit of the rings of sections over N without an elementwise germ construction.

proof.text: For a compatible family tW, construct a cone on the spectrum diagram with components tW W followed by W.toSpecΓ. Mathlib Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map and the given compatibility prove naturality. Mathlib Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_toSpecΓ identifies each spectrum projection with fromSpecStalkOfMem followed by toSpecΓ. For affine W, toSpecΓ is the hom of its canonical isoSpec. Apply IsLimit.lift and cancel this isomorphism to prove the requested factorization equations. Apply IsLimit.uniq, after composing the factorization equations with toSpecΓ, to prove uniqueness.
